Definition: from G2407; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the priesthood, priest's office.
BiblicalUsage: hierateía means office of the priesthood, priest's office. It turns up twice, in Luke and Hebrews.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hierateía as it stands — office of the priesthood, priest's office — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
